_comment: Subsumption hierarchies per constraint operand. A term maps to the list of
terms it is BROADER than: 'research' subsumes 'clinical-research'.
Without these, composing 'spatial isAnyOf {EU}' with 'spatial isAnyOf {DE}'
yields the empty set and two entirely compatible policies read as a
conflict -- which would overstate capability erosion and make the headline
result an artifact of the model rather than a finding.
Increment 3 extends this with the GA4GH Data Use Ontology hierarchy

The purpose hierarchy below encodes DUO's own ordering of data use permissions: GRU is broader than HMB, which is broader than DS. GA4GH's matching guidance states the direction explicitly -- a query for lung cancer research WILL retrieve datasets consented for cancer -- which is exactly the subsumption Taxonomy.meet implements.

DS is parameterised by disease in DUO. Representing several disease leaves matters twice over: it lets breadth distinguish HMB from DS, and it restores a real conflict mechanism, since two contributors consented for different diseases have no common purpose.
